paragraphs: The Freelander 1.8i uses the Rover K-Series engine — a 1.8-litre inline-four petrol that was fitted across the entire L314 generation from 1997 to 2006. It's a well-known engine in the British automotive landscape, shared with a number of Rover and MG models of the same era. The 1.8i was the entry-level petrol option in the Freelander range, and while the K-Series has a reputation for head gasket issues, a properly rebuilt example with updated components can be a reliable long-term proposition. The Freelander 1.8i is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace Rover K-Series engines for every Freelander 1.8i on the road.
